# Place crash reporter runtime registration on the shared parent and child path

The startup follow-ups move CrashReporter::RegisterRuntimeExceptionModule after child type and fork-server setup, before branching between parent and child startup. MakeScopeExit unregisters it when that shared scope exits. The earlier child-only placement left the parent path without registration. Current accepted code retains the shared placement. No platform startup or crash test ran here.

Scope: mail/app/nsMailApp.cpp.
